analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/hardware-support.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date on line 3 and adds a 'Gemma 4 tensor-parallel rank memory' section (head ~1125-1154). The supplied patch excerpt is truncated and head text ends at line 447, so the added section was only visible through the partial patch excerpt. I could not inspect its tail or the corresponding source changes. The unit with base lines 878-1255 is unchanged context. The new section describes per-rank memory charges for tensor-parallel Gemma 4 (weights, KV, attention transients, FP32 partials, prefix-capture allowance, activation floor, allocator cache, collective frames). It is documentation only: no executable code, no auth, attestation, encryption, key-handling, coordinator-wire or data-exposure behavior changes. The prefix-capture row mentions 'none when its cache is off', which is consistent with the existing T-041 posture (DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE gate, SSD tier). The documentation introduces no new at-rest artifact or claim contradicting T-041. It states that the activation floor is a conservative default until measured, and does not assert hardware qualification, so no threat-model assumption (T-056 overclaim of correctness) is invalidated by what is visible. Remaining integration question: any companion source changes (Gemma4TensorParallelRequestBudget, cluster TP code) are outside these units. Whether the real code matches the documented bounds, and whether it alters the cluster/TP trust boundary or the prefix-capture storage, is unverified here. Marking needs_deeper_review=false for the docs-only content, since no security conclusion is affected by anything visible.
